products.description:
Blue Mango F2 — Regular

Blue Mango is a flagship DTF Genetics breeding project built from Somango XXL × Blueberry Butcher. This listing is the regular-seed F2 release.

LineageSomango XXL × Blueberry Butcher
GenerationF2
Seed typeRegular
Pack10 seeds

Breeding direction

Project selection has focused on vigorous growth, strong branching, resin production, substantial flower structure, and a candy-blueberry-meets-ripe-mango aromatic direction.

Planning range

An 8–10 week flowering window has been used as a planning range in Blue Mango project documentation. Individual plants can finish outside that range depending on phenotype, environment, plant health, and cultivation method.

Variation matters

F2 populations can show meaningful plant-to-plant segregation. Breeding observations describe the direction of the project; they are not guarantees of phenotype, yield, potency, aroma, flavor, structure, or finish date.

products.description:
Blue Mango F2 — Feminized

This release belongs to the same Blue Mango breeding project documented across DTF Genetics. It uses the Somango XXL × Blueberry Butcher lineage in a feminized F2 release.

LineageSomango XXL × Blueberry Butcher
GenerationF2
Seed typeFeminized
Pack10 seeds

Breeding direction

The Blue Mango project is selected around vigorous growth, branching, resin production, substantial flower structure, and a candy-blueberry-meets-ripe-mango aromatic direction.

What feminized means here

Feminized describes the seed-production method and expected sex ratio. It does not mean every plant will be identical or that every observed trait will appear in every seed.

Variation still applies

Individual phenotype, growth rate, aroma, flower structure, yield, potency, and finish time can vary with genetics and environment. Project observations are context, not guarantees.

Breeding context
